title: Remove duplicates
prompt:
Write remove_duplicates(items) that returns a new list with repeated items removed, keeping the first occurrence of each and the original order.
The list you are given must not be changed.
hints: Walk through the list by hand with a pencil: for each item, how do you know whether you've seen it before?
A set remembers what it has seen and answers 'is x in it?' quickly. But a set doesn't keep order, so you also need a list for the result.
Plan: seen = empty set; result = empty list; for each item, if it isn't in seen, add it to both seen and result; return result. Don't use list(set(items)): it loses the order.

edge_hints.duplicates: When everything is repeated, only the first of each should remain. Check you add an item to the result only the first time.
edge_hints.empty: An empty list stays an empty list.
